late_joiner.goal: Enable subscribers that join after publication to receive previously published samples

writer.durability: TRANSIENT_LOCAL - Caches samples in writer memory for late joiners
writer.reliability: RELIABLE - Enables acknowledgment protocol needed for resending cached data
writer.history: KEEP_ALL - Stores all published samples (KEEP_LAST with depth=1 only keeps the latest!)

reader.durability: TRANSIENT_LOCAL - Must match writer durability for compatibility
reader.reliability: RELIABLE - Must match writer for acknowledgment protocol
reader.history: KEEP_ALL - Ensures reader can receive all cached samples

critical_notes: ALL THREE settings (durability + reliability + history) must be set on BOTH sides
TRANSIENT_LOCAL alone is NOT sufficient - RELIABLE is required to activate the resend mechanism
KEEP_LAST with default depth=1 will only deliver the most recent sample to late joiners
QoS must be compatible between writer and reader or they will not match
Use writer.wait_for_acknowledgments() instead of time.sleep() to wait for delivery
time.sleep() is a timing hack - DDS provides proper mechanisms for synchronization
late_joiner.writer_code:
writer_qos = dds.DataWriterQos()
writer_qos.durability.kind = dds.DurabilityKind.TRANSIENT_LOCAL
writer_qos.reliability.kind = dds.ReliabilityKind.RELIABLE
writer_qos.history.kind = dds.HistoryKind.KEEP_ALL
late_joiner.reader_code:
reader_qos = dds.DataReaderQos()
reader_qos.durability.kind = dds.DurabilityKind.TRANSIENT_LOCAL
reader_qos.reliability.kind = dds.ReliabilityKind.RELIABLE
reader_qos.history.kind = dds.HistoryKind.KEEP_ALL

reliable_delivery.goal: Ensure all samples are delivered reliably to all matched readers

writer.history: KEEP_ALL or KEEP_LAST with sufficient depth

reader.history: KEEP_ALL or KEEP_LAST with sufficient depth

reliable_delivery.code:
writer_qos.reliability.kind = dds.ReliabilityKind.RELIABLE
writer_qos.history.kind = dds.HistoryKind.KEEP_ALL
reader_qos.reliability.kind = dds.ReliabilityKind.RELIABLE
reader_qos.history.kind = dds.HistoryKind.KEEP_ALL

best_effort_fast.goal: Maximum throughput with no delivery guarantees
best_effort_fast.warning: Late joiners will NOT receive any previously published data with this configuration.
